popCulture.title: Ctesippus
popCulture.description: The lawless suitor from Same who hurls an ox's hoof as a 'gift' — and dies when Philoetius returns the insult.

popCulture.title: Suitors of Penelope
popCulture.description: Ctesippus of Same stands for the suitors' mockery of xenia — wealth without shame in Odysseus' hall.
